title: Publication edition/format product identifier (research candidate)
reason:
Depth: focused scope research. Confidence high in distinction, no accepted mapping. Local Pubs title_id is not ISBN; edition and format need evidence. Book metadata source/rights remain a gap.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Work, edition, media item, file, codec, Internet media type, genre and language are distinct. Local publication/track/film IDs are source-scoped; no inferred ISBN/DOI identity. Language is distinct from locale/tag and formatting culture. Compound composer/actor strings require a reviewed multiplicity policy; padding/legacy locale aliases require raw-preserving bridges. Retain the specific research distinction from this candidate. Evidence gap: final concept boundaries/operational source scope remain unproven; a source implementation and potential overlap with canonical or related research must be resolved before promotion.
practical_value: Portable book-product lookup can bridge publishers, catalogues and sales when actual ISBN exists; title label alone insufficient.
showcase_value: Edition/format/publication network with sales, only with portable keys.
